entries.en: Location shared — Café outside Huai'an Community's south gate

entries.zh: 保安跟我说，你想了解大福以前的事。
entries.en: The guard told me you want to know about Dafu's past.

entries.zh: 大福从医院回来后，起初还是躲着人。
entries.en: After returning from the hospital, Dafu still kept away from people at first.

entries.zh: 大福恢复后，也是她把大福带回社区。
entries.en: After Dafu recovered, she was also the one who brought it back to the community.

entries.zh: 大福是什么时候开始天天往这边跑的？
entries.en: When did Dafu start coming this way every day?

entries.zh: 您当时为什么连续几天给大福送吃的？
entries.en: Why did you bring Dafu food for several days in a row at the time?

entries.zh: 勒着你的东西是什么感觉？你还记得吗？
entries.en: What did the thing constricting you feel like? Do you still remember?

entries.zh: 医院检查后认为需要尽快进行颈部手术。
entries.en: After examining it, the hospital decided neck surgery was needed as soon as possible.

entries.zh: 大福没有固定主人，社区中有多人照顾。
entries.en: Dafu has no fixed owner; several people in the community look after it.

entries.zh: 大福记得有一个女人曾经给它带来食物。
entries.en: Dafu remembers a woman who used to bring it food.

entries.zh: 老式木质长椅，看上去至少服役十年了。
entries.en: An old wooden bench that looks like it's served at least ten years.

entries.zh: 获得情报——“大福成为保安猫的时间”
entries.en: Granted intel — "When Dafu became the security cat"

entries.zh: 获得情报——“社区中有多人照顾大福”
entries.en: Granted intel — "Multiple people in the community look after Dafu"

entries.zh: 请问您明天下午方便接受一个短采访吗？
entries.en: Would you be free for a short interview tomorrow afternoon?

entries.zh: 那时候不会像现在一样主动靠近保安亭。
entries.en: Back then it wouldn't approach the guard booth on its own like it does now.

entries.zh: 不知道为什么有点想喝奶茶了......
entries.en: For some reason I'm craving milk tea......

entries.zh: 伤口存在坏死和严重感染，需要尽快处理。
entries.en: The wound had necrosis and a serious infection—it needed prompt treatment.

entries.zh: 保安确认，大福康复后也是由她送回社区。
entries.en: The guard confirmed that after Dafu recovered, she was also the one who brought it back.

entries.zh: 后来又有一段时间没有力气、不想吃东西。
entries.en: Later there was another stretch when it had no energy and didn't want to eat.

entries.zh: 塑料收纳箱改造的猫屋，比出租屋还精致。
entries.en: A plastic storage bin remade into a cat house—nicer than a studio apartment.

entries.zh: 它没有长期住进女人家里，但不知道原因。
entries.en: It never moved into the woman's home long-term, but doesn't know why.

entries.zh: 手术、住院和后续治疗总费用接近一万元。
entries.en: Surgery, hospitalization, and follow-up care totaled nearly ten thousand yuan.

entries.zh: 醒来后，原本勒住脖子的东西已经不见了。
entries.en: When it woke up, the thing that had been constricting its neck was gone.

entries.zh: 大福没有离开，逐渐固定在保安亭附近生活。
entries.en: Dafu didn't leave—it gradually settled near the guard booth.

entries.zh: 当前目标更新——“向保安询问大福的情况”
entries.en: Current objective updated — "Ask the guard about Dafu"

entries.zh: 当年把大福送去治疗的人是社区居民林女士。
entries.en: The person who took Dafu for treatment back then was community resident Ms. Lin.

entries.zh: 快递柜顶留有橘色猫毛，是大福常待的位置。
entries.en: Orange cat fur on top of the parcel lockers—Dafu's usual spot.

entries.zh: 林女士家中已经有四只猫，还需要照顾女儿。
entries.en: Ms. Lin already had four cats at home, and a daughter to look after.

entries.zh: 水碗里装着大半碗清水，上面飘着几根猫毛。
entries.en: The water bowl is half full; a few cat hairs float on top.

entries.zh: 获得情报——“大福经常在保安亭附近活动”
entries.en: Granted intel — "Dafu often hangs around near the guard booth"

entries.zh: 获得情报——“大福通常在下午四五点出现”
entries.en: Granted intel — "Dafu usually appears around 4–5 p.m."

entries.zh: 保安叔叔抬头看了眼快递柜，又看了一眼时间。
entries.en: Uncle Guard looks up at the parcel lockers, then checks the time.

entries.zh: 具体怎么伤的、后来怎么治的，我就不清楚了。
entries.en: How it got hurt exactly, and how it was treated later—that part I don't know.

entries.zh: 再后来不知道什么时候，它就开始往这上面躺。
entries.en: Sometime after that, it started lying up here.

entries.zh: 决定把大福送回社区之前，您考虑了哪些情况？
entries.en: Before deciding to send Dafu back to the community, what did you take into account?

entries.zh: 小凌往灌木丛里看了一眼，但是什么都没看见。
entries.en: Ling glances into the bushes, but sees nothing.

entries.zh: 用大福提供的线索，向保安打听当年的救助者。
entries.en: Use Dafu's clues to ask the guard about who rescued it.

entries.zh: 下雨就不知道钻哪去了，反正吃饭的时候会出来。
entries.en: When it rains, who knows where it ducks off to—but it always comes out at mealtime.

entries.zh: 十几分钟后，小凌的手机收到一条新的好友申请。
entries.en: A little over ten minutes later, Ling's phone gets a new friend request.

entries.zh: 挂牌提醒不要倒剩饭，并补了一行：奶茶不算水。
entries.en: The sign says no leftovers—and adds: milk tea is not water.

entries.zh: 保安只知道它因此被人送去治疗，具体情况不清楚。
entries.en: The guard only knows it was taken for treatment because of that; the details are unclear.

entries.zh: 后来有居民换水、添粮、搭猫屋，保安也会照看它。
entries.en: Later residents changed the water, topped up the food, and built a cat house; the guard looks after it too.

entries.zh: 大福原本就在槐安社区活动，社区也已有固定投喂。
entries.en: Dafu was already active in Huai'an Community, which already had regular feeding.

entries.zh: 大福记得自己曾经被人抓住，并被带离熟悉的社区。
entries.en: Dafu remembers being caught and taken away from the community it knew.

entries.zh: 采访大福时，可以问问它以前会不会靠近这里的人。
entries.en: When interviewing Dafu, you can ask whether it used to approach people around here.

entries.zh: （还缺少相关线索。先问清当初是谁救助的大福。）
entries.en: (Not enough leads yet. First find out who rescued Dafu.)

entries.zh: 其实我一直很好奇，猫会不会把水里自己的毛喝下去。
entries.en: I've always wondered whether cats end up drinking their own fur out of the water.

entries.zh: 后来有人每天给它送吃的，它慢慢就往门口这边来了。
entries.en: Later someone brought it food every day, and it gradually started coming toward the gate.

entries.zh: 大福不知道为什么自己会被送回来，需要询问林女士。
entries.en: Dafu doesn't know why it was sent back—need to ask Ms. Lin.

entries.zh: 大福曾因颈部受伤被送医，但保安并不了解具体经过。
entries.en: Dafu was taken to a vet for a neck injury, but the guard doesn't know the details.

entries.zh: 大福记得最后是那个反复送食物的女人把它带回社区。
entries.en: Dafu remembers that in the end, the woman who kept bringing food was the one who brought it back.

entries.zh: 公司楼下要十八。突然发现了一个值得调查的社会议题。
entries.en: Eighteen downstairs at the office. Suddenly I've found a social issue worth investigating.

entries.zh: 发现伤势持续恶化后，她联系有救助经验的人协助抓捕。
entries.en: After noticing the injury kept getting worse, she contacted people with rescue experience to help catch it.

entries.zh: 大福经常趴在社区入口的快递柜上，但当前并不在附近。
entries.en: Dafu often lies on the parcel lockers at the gate, but isn't nearby right now.

entries.zh: 林女士连续四晚带食物寻找大福，每次放下后主动退远。
entries.en: Ms. Lin spent four nights in a row bringing food to find Dafu, stepping back each time after setting it down.

entries.zh: 几个猫碗并排放着，其中一个还有少量猫粮。碗底很干净。
entries.en: Several cat bowls sit side by side; one still has a little kibble. The bottoms are clean.

entries.zh: 大福（橘猫）经常和另一只狸花猫一起吃饭、休息和活动。
entries.en: Dafu (the orange cat) often eats, rests, and hangs out with another tabby.

entries.zh: 小凌刚往前靠近两步，狸花猫立刻抬起头，警惕地看向她。
entries.en: Ling takes just two steps closer, and the tabby immediately lifts its head, watching her warily.

entries.zh: 林女士确认社区有人持续照看后，将大福送回原活动区域。
entries.en: After confirming someone in the community was still looking after it, Ms. Lin returned Dafu to its original area.

entries.zh: 任务更新——“明天下午15:00前往咖啡馆采访林女士”
entries.en: Quest updated — "Tomorrow at 15:00, go to the café to interview Ms. Lin"

entries.zh: 大福不知道她是谁。也许可以拿这些特征去问认识大福的人。
entries.en: Dafu doesn't know who she is. Maybe these details can be taken to people who know Dafu.

entries.zh: 她认为自己的空间、精力和经济能力无法长期承担第五只猫。
entries.en: She felt her space, energy, and finances couldn't sustain a fifth cat long-term.

entries.zh: 林女士看到大福脖子上缠着一根较粗的麻绳，并且已经出血。
entries.en: Ms. Lin saw a fairly thick hemp rope wound around Dafu's neck—and it was already bleeding.

entries.zh: 林女士第一次发现大福时，它非常警惕，完全无法直接靠近。
entries.en: The first time Ms. Lin found Dafu, it was so wary she couldn't get near it at all.

entries.zh: 没有固定主人，多名居民会投喂、换水；保安也会顺手照看。
entries.en: No fixed owner; several residents feed it and change the water; the guard looks after it when he can.

entries.zh: 狸花猫迅速起身，一头钻进旁边的灌木丛，只剩树叶轻轻晃动。
entries.en: The tabby springs up and dives into the nearby bushes; only the leaves keep swaying gently.

entries.zh: 一只狸花猫趴在灌木丛边的草地上晒太阳，前爪交叠，眯着眼睛。
entries.en: A tabby lies on the grass by the bushes, sunbathing, front paws crossed, eyes half-closed.

entries.zh: 社区内设有长期维护的投喂点，附近居民可能了解流浪猫的情况。
entries.en: There's a long-maintained feeding spot; nearby residents may know about the strays.

entries.zh: 看来这里虽然有人固定照顾它们，但不代表它们会随便亲近陌生人。
entries.en: Looks like even with regular care, that doesn't mean they'll cozy up to strangers.

entries.zh: 阳光渐渐西斜。保安叔叔回到岗亭，小凌坐到附近的长椅上等大福。
entries.en: The sun sinks westward. Uncle Guard returns to the booth; Ling sits on a nearby bench to wait for Dafu.

entries.zh: 没有人看到麻绳最初是如何套上去的，目前无法确认是否存在人为伤害。
entries.en: No one saw how the rope first got on; whether there was intentional harm remains unconfirmed.

entries.zh: 下面还有一行明显是后来补上的：不要倒水之外的液体！！！奶茶不算水！
entries.en: Below, a line clearly added later: Do not pour liquids other than water!!! Milk tea does not count as water!

entries.zh: 这样吧，一会儿你先看看大福。我晚点帮你问问那个人愿不愿意接受采访。
entries.en: How about this—go check on Dafu for now. Later I'll ask that person if they'd be willing to be interviewed.

entries.zh: 大福只能记得身体感受，无法解释发生了什么。需要询问当时参与救助的人。
entries.en: Dafu only remembers how its body felt, not what happened. Need to ask the people involved in the rescue.

entries.zh: 忽然，一名穿着保安制服的中年男人从保安亭内走出，将保温杯放在窗台上。
entries.en: Suddenly a middle-aged man in a security uniform steps out of the guard booth and sets a thermos on the windowsill.

entries.zh: 那就行。以前胆子小，现在好多了，但不认识的人靠太近，它还是会躲着你。
entries.en: That'll do. It used to be timid; it's better now, but if strangers get too close, it'll still keep away.

entries.zh: 以前这附近猫也不少。它那时候又怕人，看见人就躲，我哪分得出来哪只是它。
entries.en: There were plenty of cats around here before. It was so shy back then—bolting at the sight of people—how was I supposed to tell which one was which?

entries.zh: 社区入口旁立着一排快递柜。柜顶铺着一块折叠纸板，上面残留着少量橘色猫毛。
entries.en: A row of parcel lockers stands by the community entrance. A folded cardboard sheet lies on top, with a few orange cat hairs left on it.

entries.zh: 面对费用和不确定的结果，林女士承认自己曾犹豫过是否继续治疗，但最后仍选择继续。
entries.en: Facing the cost and uncertain outcome, Ms. Lin admits she hesitated over whether to continue treatment—but in the end she chose to go on.

entries.zh: 明天下午三点左右我有空。小区南门外有家咖啡馆，就约在那里吧，人少一点，方便说话。
entries.en: I'm free around three tomorrow afternoon. There's a café just outside the community's south gate—let's meet there. Quieter, easier to talk.

entries.zh: 大福原本只是附近活动的流浪猫。接受救治并被放归后，它才逐渐开始在保安亭附近长期活动。
entries.en: Dafu used to just roam nearby. After treatment and release, it slowly settled around the guard booth.

entries.zh: 她还住这儿，有时候还会过来看大福。你想采访她的话，我先帮你问一声。她愿意的话，再把联系方式给你。
entries.en: She still lives here, and she comes by to see Dafu sometimes. If you want to interview her, I'll ask first. If she's willing, I'll pass along her contact info.

entries.zh: 我今天已经在社区看过大福，也跟保安了解了一些情况。还有些它当时受伤、治疗和后来送回社区的细节，想跟您核实一下。
entries.en: I've already seen Dafu in the community today, and learned a bit from the guard. There are still some details about the injury, the treatment, and how it was sent back—I'd like to verify those with you.

entries.zh: 一张老式木质长椅靠着步道摆放。绿色金属扶手已经有些掉漆，露出下面发灰的铁锈；几块木板被晒得颜色深浅不一，其中一块还微微翘起。
entries.en: An old wooden bench sits by the walkway. The green metal armrests are peeling, showing gray rust underneath; the planks have bleached unevenly in the sun, and one is slightly warped.

entries.zh: 挂牌上用记号笔写着：请不要把人类吃的剩饭倒在这里。猫粮少量添加，吃完再补，不然放久了会变质。水脏了的话麻烦帮忙换一下，谢谢。
entries.en: A sign written in marker reads: Please don't dump human leftovers here. Add cat food a little at a time—refill when it's gone, or it'll spoil. If the water's dirty, please change it. Thank you.

entries.zh: 林姐。我们小区的住户。大福脖子受伤的时候，是她找人抓住它，送去医院的。后来也是她把大福送回来的。具体怎么回事，你得问她。我也只知道个大概。
entries.en: Sister Lin. A resident of our community. When Dafu's neck was hurt, she got people to catch it and take it to the hospital. Later she brought Dafu back too. For the full story, you'll have to ask her. I only know the rough outline.

entries.zh: 猫屋是用塑料收纳箱改造的，外面罩着一层裁剪过的防水板，接缝处贴了好几道胶带，屋顶还压着两块砖，防止被风吹翻。猫屋里铺着一张旧毛毯，表面已经被抓得起了球。
entries.en: The cat house is a converted plastic storage bin, covered with cut waterproof board, seams sealed with several strips of tape, and two bricks on the roof to keep the wind from flipping it. Inside lies an old blanket, already pilled from scratching.
